decisions.reason: The same source independently changes the Small Block winner count and draw trigger, and the candidate already contains a complete same-message MODIFY.
The FAQ must reflect the revised Small and Big Block prize schedule, and its existing same-message MODIFY already records the complete updated description.
Changing the Big Block winner count and draw frequency does not change the no-code trigger, ticket award, recipient eligibility, or commission amount.
The revised prize quantities and sales thresholds do not change random ticket-weighted selection, Chainlink VRF, on-chain execution, fairness, or verification.
The draw occurs more frequently, but tickets remain independently counted and valid only until the applicable block draw, after which they reset.
The source changes prize quantities and draw thresholds but does not resolve or alter the manual-versus-automatic prize payout workflow.
The source explicitly preserves the net amount given away and does not change which sale types fund the prize pools or the funding duration.
Both Small and Big Block ticket mechanisms remain active, so both metadata counters and the other displayed metadata remain valid unchanged.
The source does not change the $5 coded-referral commission or the award of one Small Block and one Big Block ticket per successful referral.
Using sales as the draw trigger does not change the requirement to enforce a flat $10 royalty on secondary sales.
The revised prize schedule does not affect use of the NFT mint number as the permanent referral code or its display locations.
The source preserves the net prize amount and does not change the mint price, founder share, referral commission, or primary-mint funding of prize pools.
